verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. All four clauses are stated, but across two declarations rather than one. With C_* = ExponentLedger.meanExponent sigma = 1 + sigma, the Lean exponents 1 + sigma - 2*kappa and 1 + sigma + 17/100 are literally H = C_* - 2k_s and C_* + 0.17, and H matches ExponentLedger.meanUpdateExponent by definition. native_signed_mean_gain supplies E_theta, E_z in M_H and <E_theta>_Y, <E_z>_Y in M_{C_*+0.17} (with <.>_Y = StateMomentBalances.meanBar, thetaResidual/axialResidual playing E_theta/E_z for the stage output v = waveStage ...). The third clause, (P, J_theta, J_z) in S_H, is waveStage_defectBounds, and there it is stated for an arbitrary tau with 1 + tau <= alpha - kappa, i.e. more generally than the paper's single instance; the paper's H is an admissible tau because C_* - 2k <= C_* + 0.17 - k. finish_mean_stages then carries all four as one hypothesis block at exactly these exponents, which is where the conjunction (9.14) is actually used. Packaging only: nothing is weaker and nothing is missing.
